what_it_is: AI governance platform: AI discovery, testing and red teaming, policy enforcement, endpoint AI control.

1.reason: AI Discovery scans AWS, Azure, GCP, code and SaaS. Shadow AI Discovery and Endlayer find unsanctioned AI.
1.evidence: Automatically scan cloud, code & SaaS to surface every ungoverned AI use case across the organization.
1.verify_note: Cited page loads and supports the claim. Subs re-scored with the strict tests, no change.
1.has: AI Discovery scans AWS, Azure, GCP, code and SaaS. Endlayer covers devices.
1.lacks: No on-prem host or Kubernetes inventory. No CI/CD posture checks.

2.reason: Operative Guardian Agents govern tool calls and access. Endlayer inventories MCP servers and blocks agent requests on device.

3.lacks: No control-plane log detection. Blocks agent requests, not host processes.

notes: Governance-first vendor, named a Challenger in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI Governance Platforms. Three modules (Identify, Protect, Enforce) plus Guardian Agents (Sentinel observes, Operative blocks). Endlayer is a newer on-device product built by Holistic AI (macOS, Windows, Linux) with Sensor, Decoder and Guardian tiers, including a local TLS-terminating gateway. Module 7 and 8 credit is thin: 'Agent Identity' appears only as a label on the platform page, and code scanning serves AI discovery, not security flaws. Searched 'Holistic AI model file scanning malware / training data poisoning / dataset PII scan' with no hit. Credo AI calls Holistic AI a technical risk and red teaming tool.
